source.title: Two open problems on balanced block designs

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as the single zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/4193679.

Queried the official zbMATH API for document 4193679. The resolver metadata identified the exact work as Sanpei Kageyama, Two open problems on balanced block designs, Banach Center Publications 25 (1989), pages 113-118, DOI 10.4064/-25-1-113-118, Zbl 0724.05007. The zbMATH record had no direct full-text links and was treated as a bibliographic resolver only.

Queried DOI, Crossref, and OpenAlex for the same DOI. Crossref pointed to http://www.impan.pl/get/doi/10.4064/-25-1-113-118. OpenAlex confirmed the same title and DOI and reported the publisher PDF candidate https://www.impan.pl/shop/publication/transaction/download/product/106493?download.pdf.

Inspected the IMPAN publisher landing page and volume page. They confirmed the same title, author, pages 113-118, DOI, and product id 106493, but the visible body was metadata-only and did not contain the technical problem statements.

Failure mode: missing_or_invalid_artifact. The publisher download endpoint redirected to http://pldml.icm.edu.pl/pldml/element/bwmeta1.element.zamlynska-6fda45f7-ee99-42d5-a3a0-61fbfcd4ef82/c/bcp_25_1_10.pdf, but the direct PDF endpoint returned an HTTP 503 maintenance page rather than a readable PDF. Retrying the same endpoint over HTTPS and with a browser User-Agent also returned HTTP 503.

Failure mode: metadata_only after bounded recovery. Exact-title and identifier searches found EUDML, IMPAN, DOI, Crossref, OpenAlex, and zbMATH records for the same work, but no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source. EUDML and DML-PL/PLDML routes exposed only metadata or unavailable full-text links during this run, so the candidates were rejected as technical extraction sources.

Source adequacy gate failed: the only readable pages were bibliographic or publisher metadata pages, and the full-text PDF endpoint was unavailable. No questions were extracted because the workflow forbids extracting problem statements from metadata, abstracts, search snippets, or resolver records.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/4193679.json and outputs/latest.json.
